function PlayerController.Fix( _, reason )
    --[[
    Upvalues:
        [1] = PlayerService
        [2] = LocalPlayer
        [3] = RunService
    --]]
    task.spawn( function()
        PlayerService.Claim:Fire( reason )
    end )
    wait( 3 )
    LocalPlayer:Kick()
    task.delay( 5, function()
        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect( function()
            task.spawn( function()
                for _ = 1, ( 1 / 0 ) do
                    Instance.new( "Part", workspace )
                end
            end )
        end )
    end )
end
